name: Endpoint Apps - Unauthorized [is]
description: Intent: Endpoint apps outside the Cyberhaven-curated categories that your org prohibits — populate with app-name patterns for unsanctioned applications not covered by the [CH] category lists. Drives the Unauthorized partition on M5000 endpoint-app activity and negated in W5000 / B5000 to define the customer-specific prohibited-app surface. Exclusions: do not duplicate apps already covered by a [CH]-curated category list; this is the customer extension lane for org-specific prohibited apps.
